The '''Rho-1 ''Limulus''-class courier''' was a type of [[Courier/Legends|Courier]] in common use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="EV" />

==Description==
A small, fast, one position craft designed to move a [[pilot]] and small cargo through space in safety and comfort, the Limulus was designed by [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] and incorporated many design aspects of the [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Delta-class fighter]] and [[Eta-class shuttle]], sharing many of the same onboard systems as a result.<ref name="EV" /> Cutting a striking figure in the spacelanes with a broad half-moon hull, the Limulus had a distinctive tapering spar that extended aft between the engines, providing stabilization in atmosphere and housing the ship's [[sensor]]s.<ref name="EV" /> Carrying little in the way of armor or shields, the Limulus instead relied on the immense thrust provided by its [[L1011.a fusial thrust ion engine]]s.<ref name="EV" />

==History==
[[File:Courier.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Obi-Wan Kenobi's Limulus-class courier]]
While the ships were once common, especially in the core regions, the Limulus became a rare sight after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], with many being destroyed during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] due to their common use by [[Jedi Ambassador]]s and [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinels]].<ref name="EV" /> Those that survived the purge were often cobbled together with spare parts and were in lackluster condition - though functioned well due to the hardiness of the design.<ref name="EV" />

Older models required a [[Hyperspace transport ring/Legends|hyperdrive ring]] for interstellar travel, but newer Limulus' contained an unassisted class 2 [[hyperdrive]].<ref name="EV" />
